newsitem.title: FINLAND: Rautaruukki sets DEM 400 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Rautaruukki sets DEM 400 mln loan.

text.p: Finnish steel group Rautaruukki Oy said in a statement on Wednesday it had signed an agreement with a syndicate of 27 international banks on a 400 million German mark seven-year loan.
"The margin is LIBOR +0.25 (percentage points) per annum in the first four years and LIBOR +0.275 (percentage points) per annum in the final three years," Rautaruukki said.
"The loan is Rautaruukki's largest financial arrangement ever and it will be used mainly to repay old loans," Rautaruukki said.
The lead managers of the loan are Danish Den Danske Bank, Swedish Eskilda and Finnish Merita Bank, it said.
